title: TPLF Says Drone Strike Kills Up to 13 in Hintalo Wajirat, South of Mekelle
detail: A reported drone strike hit the May Shemet area of Freweyni Tabia, Hintalo Wajirat woreda, roughly south of Mekelle, at approximately 2:30am local time. TPLF Vice President Amanuel Assefa told AFP there was a drone strike in Hintalo district that morning. Tigray's regional Communication Bureau, via Dimtsi Weyane Television, initially reported three family members killed including a mother and a 4-year-old child, with the toll later reported rising to 13; AFP separately confirmed at least 3 wounded, including one Tigrayan fighter, at a nearby hospital, and could not independently verify the higher death toll or attribution. The Ethiopian federal government and ENDF had not responded to requests for comment at time of reporting. ACLED recorded 14 drone strikes in Tigray during 2026, part of a pattern of aerial operations amid the collapsing Pretoria ceasefire.

media.caption: Smoke rises after a reported air strike on Tigray as fears of renewed war grow

confidenceReason: The strike itself and some casualties are confirmed by AFP via a medical source, but the death toll is disputed — Tigray's Communication Bureau reports up to 13 killed while AFP could only independently confirm 3 wounded; attribution to the federal government rests solely on the TPLF's account.
